votes.motion: Close all three hearings for 30 Summer St.
votes.quote: a. burney moved to close all three hearings. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye; m. brenner, aye. (4/0)

votes.motion: Approve Stormwater Permit PBSW-25-6 with standard conditions
votes.quote: a. burney moved to approve stormwater permit pbsw-25-6 with standard conditions. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; a. burney, aye; t. wilsmer, aye; m. brenner, aye (4/0)

votes.motion: Approve Site Plan PBSA-25-8 with standard and additional conditions regarding truck rentals, security system, operating hours 6am to 10pm, and construction hours 7am to 5pm weekdays and 8am to 2pm Saturday
votes.quote: a. burney moved to approve site plan pbsa-25-8 with standard and the additional conditions, no truck rentals are allowed on the property, if the applicant wants to have truck rentals in the future, a modification will be required, will work with the police department on the installation of a security system, operating hours are to be 6am to 10pm monday through sunday, and construction hours are 7am to 5pm monday through friday and 8am to 2pm on saturday. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye; m. brenner, aye (4/0)

votes.motion: Approve Special Permit for Flood Plain PBSP-25-9 with standard conditions
votes.quote: a. burney moved to approve special permit for flood plain pbsp-25-9 with standard conditions. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye, m. brenner, aye (4/0)

votes.motion: Continue all permits for 10 Parmenter Rd to July 13, 2026 at 6:05pm
votes.quote: a. burney moved to continue all permits to july 13, 2026, at 6:05pm. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; a. burney, aye; t. willsmer, aye; m. brenner, aye (4/0)

votes.motion: Continue permits for 934 Mass Ave to July 13, 2026 at 6:05pm
votes.quote: a. burney moved to continue to 7/13/26, at 6:05pm. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; a. burney, aye; a. nicastro, aye; t. willsmer, aye; m. brenner, aye (5/0)
a. burney moved to close the hearing. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye; a. nicastro, aye; m. brenner, aye (5/0)

votes.motion: Find the 1800 square foot changes to Stormwater permit 1294 to be De Minimis based on the nature of the impervious and confirmation from Graves that the proposed will handle the additional runoff
votes.quote: a. burney moved to find the 1800 square foot changes to stormwater 1294 approved 2/27/2023 to be de minimis based on the nature of the impervious and confirmation from graves that the proposed will handle the additional runoff. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye; a. nicastro, aye; m. brenner, aye (5/0)

votes.motion: Approve the De minimis changes to stormwater permit 1294
votes.quote: a. burney moved to approve the de minimis changes to stormwater permit 1294. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye; a. nicastro, aye; m. brenner, aye (5/0)

votes.motion: Approve the Site Plan for 1325 Massachusetts Ave with standard conditions and construction hours 7am to 5pm Monday through Friday, 8am to 12pm Saturdays, no work on Sundays and Holidays
votes.quote: a. burney moved to approve the site plan with standard conditions and construction hours 7am -5pm monday through friday, 8am -12pm saturdays. no work to be done on sundays and holidays. a. reid, second roll call vote: a. reid, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. burney, aye; a. nicastro, aye; m. brenner, aye (5/0)

votes.motion: Accept the $4550.00 Performance Guarantee Bond for 189 Electric Ave
votes.quote: a. burney moved to accept the $4550.00 bond for 189 electric ave. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye, a. burney, aye, a. nicastro, aye, t. willsmer, aye, m. brenner, aye (5/0)

votes.motion: Accept the bond language and bond of $250,000 for 485 Leominster Shirley Rd decommissioning
votes.quote: a. burney moved to accept the bond language and bond of $250,000. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; a. burney; aye, t. willsmer, aye; a. nicastro, aye; m. brenner, aye (5/0)
a. burney moved to adjourn. a. reid, second. roll call vote: a. reid, aye; a. burney, aye; t. willsmer, aye; a. nicastro, aye, & m. brenner, aye (5/0)
